title: Detailed spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow/ground glow beneath top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#2a1a4a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- spinning motion arcs -->
  <path d="M 18 50 Q 10 30 30 18" stroke="#7ee8fa" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 82 50 Q 90 30 70 18" stroke="#7ee8fa" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 22 62 Q 8 55 12 38" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 78 62 Q 92 55 88 38" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- handle stem -->
  <rect x="46" y="8" width="8" height="18" rx="3" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <rect x="47" y="8" width="3" height="18" rx="1.5" fill="#ffd97a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- knob on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="6.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffb3d1" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- upper body dome -->
  <path d="M 32 30 Q 50 18 68 30 L 70 48 Q 50 54 30 48 Z" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- dome highlight -->
  <path d="M 38 32 Q 50 24 62 32 Q 50 30 38 32 Z" fill="#ffb3d1" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- decorative band upper -->
  <path d="M 30 48 Q 50 54 70 48 L 71 54 Q 50 60 29 54 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <path d="M 31 50 Q 50 56 69 50" stroke="#ffec8b" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- middle stripe -->
  <path d="M 29 56 Q 50 62 71 56 L 72 64 Q 50 70 28 64 Z" fill="#7ee8fa"/>
  <path d="M 30 58 Q 50 64 70 58" stroke="#c8f7ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- lower body cone -->
  <path d="M 28 64 Q 50 70 72 64 L 56 84 Q 50 88 44 84 Z" fill="#9b5de5"/>
  <!-- cone highlight -->
  <path d="M 36 66 Q 46 70 50 82 Q 44 78 38 68 Z" fill="#c09cf0" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- decorative diamonds on lower cone -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="76" r="2" fill="#7ee8fa"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="76" r="2" fill="#7ee8fa"/>

  <!-- base ring -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="10" ry="3" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="7" ry="2" fill="#ffd97a"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffec8b">
    <path d="M 22 28 l 1.5 4 l 4 1.5 l -4 1.5 l -1.5 4 l -1.5 -4 l -4 -1.5 l 4 -1.5 Z"/>
    <path d="M 78 32 l 1 3 l 3 1 l -3 1 l -1 3 l -1 -3 l -3 -1 l 3 -1 Z"/>
    <path d="M 15 70 l 1 2.5 l 2.5 1 l -2.5 1 l -1 2.5 l -1 -2.5 l -2.5 -1 l 2.5 -1 Z"/>
    <path d="M 85 68 l 1 2.5 l 2.5 1 l -2.5 1 l -1 2.5 l -1 -2.5 l -2.5 -1 l 2.5 -1 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- little stars -->
  <g fill="#c8f7ff">
    <circle cx="26" cy="20" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="22" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="48" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="46" r="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
